submission.natural_language_explanation: Retrospective local phrase-completion detector: the pole fires on the token that completes a short-range chunk opened by the preceding one or two tokens — the second half of a fixed collocation (compared with, at least), a subword continuation (Se+ine, am+oxic), or a content word filling a slot set by a nearby function word (void because, hiked to, in O). The same surface token fires strongly with its opener present and weakly when the opener is swapped out.
